name: Music With Harmony
source:
After another boring day of work, you decide to relax by watching something from your VHS tape collection. You find something from your childhood:

Music With Harmony.

The show that got you into music.

It's innocent at first, but the main character, Harmony, is more self aware than you first thought.

[From [url=https://kawffee.itch.io/music-with-harmony]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经过一天无聊的工作后，你决定观看VHS磁带收藏中的一些内容来放松一下。你会发现一些童年的事情：

音乐与和谐。

让你爱上音乐的节目。

一开始很天真，但主角Harmony比你最初想象的更有自我意识。

[来自[url=https://kawffee.itch.io/music-with-harmony]itch.io[/url]]
